root.label: Third-quarter 2026 G7 bond-yield surge and debt analysis

events.label: Third-quarter 2026 G7 bond-yield surge and debt analysis

slots.name: US yield jump
slots.sentence: Over the course of the third quarter, the yield on 10-year U.S. Treasurys jumped by 0.83 percentage point, according to FactSet, the biggest quarterly increase since 1994.

slots.name: France yield jump
slots.sentence: France and Italy, saw even bigger leaps in their 10-year bond yields at 1.29 and 1.28 percentage points, respectively.

slots.name: Italy debt ratio
slots.sentence: Italy had the highest debt load of the group at 149% of GDP in 2025, according to data from the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development.

slots.name: US debt ratio
slots.sentence: That compares with 126% in the U.S. France isn’t far behind at 117% of GDP

slots.name: Japan yield jump
slots.sentence: The notable outlier is Japan, which has the highest debt ratio in the group and—despite all the negative headlines the country garners—also saw the smallest jump in 10-year yields at around 0.4 percentage point in the third quarter.

slots.name: Japan gross debt
slots.sentence: Japan’s gross debt looks huge at over 200% of GDP.

slots.name: Japan deficit
slots.sentence: In 2024, the last year with full data available for all seven countries, Japan’s central government deficit was 1.7% of GDP, according to the OECD.

slots.name: G7 deficit average
slots.sentence: That compares with an average of 4.7% for the rest of the G7.

slots.name: France debt ratio
slots.sentence: France isn’t far behind at 117% of GDP
